name: ff
description: Fyxer factory — run a feature idea→open PR through a left-shifted gated pipeline, start from an investigation (ff:investigate) when the input is a reported bug, or enter at any phase (plan/build/review/ci-green) and resume from saved state in .scratch/<slug>/.

branchPrefix.title: Branch author prefix
branchPrefix.description: Prefix for branches ff creates: <prefix>/feat-PRE-123-title. Leave blank to use your shell username (whoami). Prompted once at install; change later with /plugin configure ff.

prAssignee.title: PR assignee
prAssignee.description: GitHub login that ff assigns the PRs it opens to. Leave blank to assign them to yourself (@me). Prompted once at install; change later with /plugin configure ff.

linearProject.title: Linear project
linearProject.description: Name of the Linear project ff searches when it links a PR to an issue, and checks when it updates the issue after merge, such as your pod's project. Leave blank to search all issues assigned to you and skip the project check. Prompted once at install; change later with /plugin configure ff.

worktreeRoot.title: Worktree folder
worktreeRoot.description: Folder new worktrees go in: an absolute path, a ~/ path, or a path relative to the main checkout, such as .claude/worktrees. Leave blank to put them beside the main checkout. Prompted once at install; change later with /plugin configure ff.
